tagline.en: The world's first eSIM store with 200+ destinations
tagline.zh: 全球首家eSIM商店，覆盖200+目的地

description.en: Airalo is the world's leading eSIM marketplace, offering prepaid data plans for more than 200 countries and regions. Plans start from 1GB for 3 days, install in minutes via the iOS/Android app, and top-ups are instant. A solid default choice for most travelers.
description.zh: Airalo 是全球领先的eSIM商城，为200多个国家和地区提供预付费流量套餐。套餐从1GB/3天起，通过iOS/Android应用几分钟即可安装激活，续购即时生效。是大多数旅行者的稳妥之选。

details.en:
Airalo's strength is consistency at scale: 200+ destinations with a uniform buying flow, an app that stores all your eSIMs in one place, and instant top-ups that add data to a running eSIM without reinstalling. Its catalogue splits into three tiers — local plans for a single country, regional plans (Asia, Europe, Africa and more) covering dozens of countries each, and a global plan usable almost everywhere — which makes it easy to pick the right scope. Verified pricing from the official storefront: a Japan eSIM runs US$4.00 for 1 GB / 3 days up to US$25.00 for 20 GB / 30 days, with unlimited options from US$11.50 / 3 days; the USA is similar (1 GB / 3 days from US$4.00, 20 GB / 30 days US$36.50, plus 50 GB and unlimited tiers). Airalo also runs Discover+ global multi-network plans and frequent seasonal discounts in the app.

Support is 24/7 and genuinely multilingual, and the regional packages (e.g. shared data across 10+ Asian countries) remain the reference point that other providers' regional offers are compared against.
details.zh:
Airalo 的强项在于规模化的一致性：200+ 目的地统一购买流程，App 集中管理所有 eSIM，续购即时生效且无需重装。

套餐目录分三层——单国本地包、覆盖数十国的区域包（亚洲、欧洲、非洲等）以及几乎全球通用的全球包——选择范围一目了然。经官方商店核验的价格：日本 eSIM 从 1 GB / 3 天 4.00 美元到 20 GB / 30 天 25.00 美元，另有 11.50 美元/3 天起的不限量档；美国相近（1 GB / 3 天 4.00 美元起，20 GB / 30 天 36.50 美元，另有 50 GB 与不限量档）。App 内还有 Discover+ 全球多网络套餐与季节性折扣。客服 7×24 小时多语言在线；区域包（如 10+ 亚洲国家共享流量）是全行业区域套餐的比价基准。

bestFor.zh: 首次使用 eSIM 的用户与多国行程——目录最全、App 体验最可预期的稳妥默认选择。

country.en: varies (commonly Singapore/France/US, not the destination country)
country.zh: varies (commonly Singapore/France/US, not the destination country)

note.en: Academic measurement (arXiv 2408.14923) shows most Airalo eSIMs are roaming-based with IPX hub breakout: public-internet gateways commonly sit at Singapore Singtel (AS45143), France OVH (AS16276) or US Packet Host (AS54825), i.e. datacenter IPs unrelated to the visited country. Airalo itself does not guarantee IP geolocation matches the destination.
note.zh: arXiv 2408.14923 实测：Airalo 多为漫游架构，出口常见新加坡 Singtel(AS45143)、法国 OVH(AS16276)、美国 Packet Host(AS54825)，即机房 IP，与所在地无关；官方也不保证 IP 与目的地一致。
